name: splendor-quantum-wallet
description: Splendor Quantum Wallet — Chrome extension. Quantum-safe Dilithium wallet for Splendor Quantum Chain.

scripts.copy:wasm: mkdir -p wasm && cp ../sdk/bridge/wasm/dist/sqc_signer.wasm wasm/ && cp ../sdk/bridge/wasm/dist/wasm_exec.js wasm/
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm && echo 'Extension ready — load wallet-extension/ in Chrome'
scripts.dev: npm run copy:wasm && echo 'Load wallet-extension/ as unpacked extension in chrome://extensions'
